title: Brassworks: Rise of the Sniffer
description: Brassworks: Rise of the Sniffer is a resource pack that gives Brassworks a Sniffer-themed GUI makeover, bringing a fresh look inspired by Minecraft's ancient gardener. More updates and improvements are planned in the future. 👀
body:
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cf797ee62d57a6f5ce1a79e34ddcdc4140613ea7.png)

Brassworks: Rise of the Sniffer is a Minecraft resource pack that brings a custom Sniffer-inspired theme to your game’s interface and visuals.

This pack focuses on reworking the game’s GUI elements, giving menus, inventories, and interface screens a unique Sniffer-themed style while keeping the vanilla Minecraft feel intact.

It is designed to enhance immersion without changing gameplay, making it a lightweight visual upgrade for players who enjoy themed UI packs.
